dogecoin.text: As of now, Dogecoin is holding steady at around $0.33, with investors clinging to the idea that this coincidence somehow spells its future as an unofficial government-backed currency. (5/5) https://t.co/dAiPwfyn8P

The irony? A committee meant to cut inefficiency inadvertently inflated a speculative bubble. Musk’s connection and Dogecoin’s shared acronym transformed this policy exercise into a meme-fueled market phenomenon. (3/5) https://t.co/NZ0o9PCNqd

This coincidental alignment of meme culture and governance fueled Dogecoin’s rise, leaving speculators convinced of its newfound legitimacy. Since DOGE isn’t federal, neither Musk nor Ramaswamy must submit financial disclosures. This raises concerns about “double-dipping.” (2/5) https://t.co/ojisrcAlvq

The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) isn’t a real agency but an advisory committee. Its acronym, coinciding with Dogecoin, sparked a speculative frenzy, sending the crypto soaring from $0.16 to $0.38. Musk, co-leading DOGE, owns undisclosed amounts of Dogecoin. (1/5) https://t.co/zGcJ14TbPm

Trump’s $TRUMP crypto hit $27 billion in hours, turning a near-miss into profit. Unlike Elon’s Dogecoin, this bulldozes ethical lines as Trump rewrites crypto laws while profiting. Critics call it audacious; Scaramucci dubs it “next-level corruption.” https://t.co/Y3aMXlbMzq
